study.question: Within the incumbent eight target/recency slots, does retaining which historical items received each feedback improve four-task validation prediction beyond separately retained item means, feedback composition and added readout capacity?
study.hypothesis: Observed: g2-r0001-uniform_summary macro AUC=0.8225477995907426, macro Logloss=0.05516469399837854, wall=278.814s, p50 model batch=10.098ms. DIN: 0.8099233880793816, 0.05662295138414975, 329.113s, 15.292ms. Uniform versus learned target_early improves AUC by 0.0016919374 but worsens macro Logloss by 0.0000682583; do not equate ranking gain with calibration gain. Content-only learned=0.8206157877; counts-only learned=0.7669714772; no-history=0.7313912513. Thus content matters in the learned branch, while explicit counts alone do not explain the full gain; these removals are not a uniform-branch factorial. Early target routing beats position routing by 0.0067677569, whereas late scoring does not beat early in either grouping. The original 2x2 interaction is about +0.0008592421 AUC, without repetition uncertainty. Code observation: uniform mean of concatenated item and action embeddings is invariant to permuting actions among items inside the same slot. Mechanism hypothesis: this erases useful within-slot item-feedback association. Add linear feedback-conditioned item moments, keeping all base summaries. Compare joint J_st=E_s[(W x_i)b_it] against factorized F_st=E_s[W x_i]E_s[b_it]; their difference is a projected covariance. No observed metric yet supports this new mechanism. Long-history slice gt64 favors uniform over DIN (0.8476959318 vs 0.8273443710, n=1401885); empty-history macro AUC worsens (0.7192081601 vs 0.7268428930, n=6444), so overall gains do not apply to every slice. Per-task incumbent measurements and deltas (validation only): is_click: AUC=0.6624085610133991, Logloss=0.18247720945293472, delta(DIN) AUC=0.006864478593365475, Logloss=-0.000919593104971167, delta(learned target_early) AUC=-0.0002659858387585867, Logloss=-0.00015422282806690224; cart: AUC=0.8612991070078048, Logloss=0.018036015330106295, delta(DIN) AUC=0.01222940505430914, Logloss=-0.0018461659235353284, delta(learned target_early) AUC=0.0018237824388218637, Logloss=0.00029610792354175033; fav: AUC=0.8715746665977827, Logloss=0.013598907548975565, delta(DIN) AUC=0.006677173709413897, Logloss=-0.0013544327907662468, delta(learned target_early) AUC=0.0034872706053382663, Logloss=8.22832015122902e-05; buy: AUC=0.8949088637439842, Logloss=0.006546643661497582, delta(DIN) AUC=0.024726588688355866, Logloss=-0.001712837723812104, delta(learned target_early) AUC=0.0017226824244928052, Logloss=4.886491042530028e-05. Slice counts (same sample identities for DIN/incumbent): empty_history counts {"is_click": {"positive": 427, "negative": 6017}, "cart": {"positive": 45, "negative": 6399}, "fav": {"positive": 28, "negative": 6416}, "buy": {"positive": 13, "negative": 6431}}; history_gt64 counts {"is_click": {"positive": 50957, "negative": 1350928}, "cart": {"positive": 3948, "negative": 1397937}, "fav": {"positive": 3318, "negative": 1398567}, "buy": {"positive": 1510, "negative": 1400375}}. All nine supplied trajectories succeeded; no failed execution receipt is present. Lower-performing and slower branches are retained in evidence, not treated as mechanism refutations. These slice comparisons are exploratory.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text arXiv:1706.06978v4, lines219-282 inspected; DIN uses target-conditioned event weighting and discusses interest intensity. This study keeps deterministic target slots, no learned event scorer, and contrasts feedback-item joint versus marginal moments. Multiplicative interaction itself is inherited common practice; no originality claim.

Pinned benchmark implementation 90bb99a lines80-128 inspected: target attention precedes heterogeneous field/task interactions. Here binary historical feedback conditions linear content moments before final pooling/readout; no HiFormer interaction blocks. Original paper full text not audited.

Pinned benchmark lines75-159 inspected: target-attention summary then global/group token mixing. Here association preservation happens during compression, with unchanged simple four MLP readouts and no reversible mixer. Does not establish novelty against the original method.

Pinned query/token projection construction lines60-105 inspected and cached benchmark section2.3 read. Existing ordinal last16/earlier split is inherited; no fixed/conditioned query mixer or day-based real-time claim. Original paper is provenance-only in registry.

Only author README, including category/brand/behavior-type field warning, is available. Current adapter supplies past ad-exposure item IDs; auxiliary labels match user/category/brand over24h. Do not transfer original-data assumptions or claim DMR reproduction.

study.proposed_difference: Add a shared bias-free item projection W: key_width ->8 and four feedback channels per target slot (256 new content coordinates), plus32 within-slot feedback fractions. Binary masks come exclusively from supplied historical task masks; intersect with history_mask, permit overlaps, ignore current action/labels. Divide joint sums by all valid events in their parent slot, so J and F have an exact covariance interpretation; no rare-positive denominator. Joint and factorized models execute both computations and only select at final feature assembly. Composition and widened-parent controls zero paths at the same point. All four use identical widened architecture and initialization order. Fixed source/API contracts unchanged. Source checks and scalar algebra passed; Torch is unavailable here, so host forward/backward/BF16 checks remain prerequisites. This is a prospective design difference, with originality unverified.
predictions: Primary: feedback_joint exceeds feedback_factorized in equal-weight validation macro AUC under the frozen single-pass recipe. Also compare to composition-only, widened parent, incumbent and DIN; report macro Logloss and all four task AUC/Logloss deltas without undeclared task vetoes.

Mechanism prediction: within-slot permutation of entire four-bit feedback vectors while keeping item sequence, routing, fraction counts and embeddings fixed leaves factorized feedback features unchanged but can change joint features. Permuting matched item-feedback pairs inside a fixed slot leaves both unchanged. One-event and empty-slot J-F are exactly zero.

Predeclare existing history-length bins empty,1-16,17-64,>64. Pairing contribution should be concentrated in nonempty slots with varied item vectors and feedback patterns; empty histories contain no such evidence. Slice metrics remain exploratory and require sample/positive/negative counts. Joint may affect empty-history predictions indirectly through training, so no equality of independently trained output predictions is predicted.

Dense parameter increment is 4*128*(8*4*(8+1)) + key_width*8 =147456 + key_width*8; with six16-d item fields this is148224, total32288965 relative to32140741. All four variants share allocated size; zero controls have smaller effective active capacity. Measure rather than infer cost improvements.
falsifiers: If joint does not outperform factorized and composition-only under paired repetitions, there is no controlled support that preserved item-feedback association improves this protocol. A single failed initialization or implementation does not refute the broader information-loss hypothesis.
If joint and factorized improve equally over composition-only, prefer the explanation of added nonlinear marginal interactions or capacity; do not attribute the gain to event pairing.
If composition-only matches joint while beating widened parent, explicit feedback prevalence suffices at tested capacity; reject a pairing-specific interpretation.

If source/host checks find dependence on masked payloads, target action/current labels, unstable empty-history values, nonfinite outputs/gradients or incorrect feedback shapes, mark execution invalid and retain its costs. Do not change the frozen loader or visibility contract.
If the candidate costs more than DIN and fails to improve the measured quality-cost frontier against uniform_summary, do not claim more efficient compression even if its AUC rises.
alternative_explanations: Single-seed random variation; repeated user exposures are dependent. Paired seeds and authorized paired user-cluster bootstrap are needed before significance claims.

Added explicit action composition, wider first tower layer, changed fan-in and random-number consumption relative to incumbent; within-round factorized/composition/parent controls address parts of these confounds.

Joint and factorized differ in representation scale and gradient paths as well as covariance availability. Positive results support the implemented association path, not an abstract scale-free information theorem; poor normalization or one-pass optimization may conceal useful information.

Projected eight-dimensional content may underrepresent rare feedback. Masks overlap and zero masks include exposure-only histories; missing behavior and genuine lack of behavior cannot be separated here.

Offline label-aligned category/brand routing and released delayed feedback can help ranking under this benchmark while failing production point-in-time semantics. No production claim or ad-specific shopping attribution.

Shared embedding learning changes across interventions. More effective parameters in active branches cannot be equated with allocated parameter matching. Existing count/content controls use learned gating and do not fully identify interactions under uniform pooling.

variants.name: feedback_factorized
